svg.text: U1: stand-alone PD sink; no NVM. ADC straps 3/5/1/0
15 V min/max, 1 A operating / 1.5 A maximum; I2C 0x21
PPHV can carry default 5 V: U2 lockout + firmware qualification required.
D1: 22 V VBUS flat clamp; surge margin requires qualification.
D2: CC-only 5.5 V ESD. Never connect D2 to VBUS.
J1 shield tied directly to local ground; USB data unused.
U3: 3.3 V / 150 mA control LDO, 30 V input rating.
EN floating = enabled. Intended control load <15 mA.
Power present does not mean motor ready.
